adopted_via_rule.exact_position_net_rule:
# Four exact low-current control escapes only; PCBWay advanced DFM/price pending.
(rule "Four exact converter control escapes"
  (condition "A.Type == 'Via' && ((A.NetName == '/motherboard_power_entry/C_PGOOD' && A.Position_X == 234.650000mm && A.Position_Y == 156.180000mm) || (A.NetName == '/motherboard_power_entry/CORE_CORE_CONFIG' && A.Position_X == 237.380000mm && A.Position_Y == 156.450000mm) || (A.NetName == '/motherboard_power_entry/C_PGOOD' && A.Position_X == 230.650000mm && A.Position_Y == 182.180000mm) || (A.NetName == '/motherboard_power_entry/MOTION_CORE_CONFIG' && A.Position_X == 233.380000mm && A.Position_Y == 182.450000mm))")
  (constraint via_diameter (min 0.40mm) (max 0.40mm))
  (constraint hole_size (min 0.20mm) (max 0.20mm))
  (constraint annular_width (min 0.10mm)))
